links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT output with no reading-level or audience instruction
links.outcome: Readability (grade level) and quality of patient education content
links.effect: Default ChatGPT averaged grade level 12.16; the readability-adjusted prompt (ChatGPT-a) gave 7.50 and retained high quality, whereas Epic Easy to Read reached 3.53 but did not retain high quality.
links.quote: When adjusted for user education level (ChatGPT-a and Epic Easy to Read), readability improved (7.50 and 3.53), but only ChatGPT-a retained high quality.
